ops.title: roll: identify installed desks through the binrun shim
ops.description:
Owner: desk-roll-on-install implementation caller.
Review scope: staged diff; source inspection only; no tests run.
Severity: major
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lr/internal/roll/roll.go:34 — Watch compares os.Executable to current/bin/lr, but bin/lr:37-38 exports BINRUN_PLUGIN_ROOT and execs binrun; the executable is a cached native binary while EvalSymlinks(current/bin/lr) resolves the shell shim. All normal launchd desks skip watching, including the desk-creds stale report.
Next executable step: Use the immutable plugin origin exported by the shim to identify the running installed pack.

ops.text: The ordinary current/bin/lr shim launch enables roll watching.
A promotion drains the four desks and posts a stale state from desk-creds without restarting it.
